name: Adobe Lightroom API
description: Lightroom automation for Adobe Firefly Services (image.adobe.io/lrService): a LightroomPort + adapter for auto-tone, preset application, and parametric edits over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async, batch-oriented photo editing / color grading.

questions.prompt: Which Lightroom operations will you use?

checklist: Confirm the Lightroom API entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project (same IMS Server-to-Server auth as Firefly)
Verify the current endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — the Lightroom API lives on image.adobe.io/lrService (same host as Photoshop, different service path; the client posts absolute URLs there)
Provide presigned input (+ preset for applyPreset) and output hrefs — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
Batch-oriented: drive autoTone/edit over many images by calling the port per asset (or fan out with the bullmq template)
Default output format defaults to ADOBE_LIGHTROOM_FORMAT (set at install)
